name: Simulator-as-Proxy World Model for Robot Manipulation
title: Simulator-as-Proxy World Model for Robot Manipulation
summary: SimPWM uses a parameter-free simulator as a proxy to generate robot videos and simulated states, revealing that video models follow arm motion more reliably than object dynamics and often ignore simulated object state.
